title: REQ · cn helper and shadcn/Radix Button are available
summary: cn utility, components.json and a Radix-based Button
description: Context: no cn helper or shadcn components exist. Desired behavior: src/lib/utils.ts exports cn (clsx + tailwind-merge), components.json configures shadcn, and src/components/ui/button.tsx implements the shadcn Button using class-variance-authority and @radix-ui/react-slot. Expected result: reusable primitives for later slices.
acceptance_criteria: Given cn('px-2','px-4'), when called, then it returns 'px-4'
Given cn('a', false && 'b', 'c'), when called, then it returns 'a c'
Given Button with asChild wrapping an anchor, when rendered, then an anchor element carries the button classes
Given Button variant default, when rendered, then it has the bg-primary class
definition_of_done: Helper and Button exist and tests pass
